stay.price_basis: No usable 2026 price. Forest-department tariff card printed on the Changlang district site ('Last Updated 15.11.2020'): Deban Forest Rest House double occupancy Rs 190 (single Rs 145), Tourist Hut double Rs 95 (single Rs 50), Dormitory Rs 30 per bed; foreigners pay double; 'rates are subject to revision'. Transindiatravels.com prints the same FRH and dorm figures (hut Rs 90) without a date. This is a 2020 tariff, undated for 2026, so treat as a floor not a market price.
stay.notes: Not loaded as medians: the only printed forest-department tariff is a 2020 card (Deban Forest Rest House Rs 190 double, tourist hut Rs 95, dormitory Rs 30 per bed, at https://changlang.nic.in/how-to-reach-namdapha/), which is stale and below plausible market range. Likely stale: the Changlang 'Where to Stay' page (22.12.2020) prints no tariff for Miao properties or the Namdapha Jungle Camp, and the park's own charges page (namdaphatigerreserve.org/Charges.php) now 301-redirects to an unrelated site (bekkybarber.com), so no current tariff could be opened; figures a search snippet attributed to that page were not used. Booking is through the Field Director, Miao (03807-222249) or the ADC Miao. No mid tier or homestay price was opened.
